broadcasts.message: normalize.js remains faithful and stable. It performs NFKC, lowercase, whitespace collapse to single space, and trim, with no other transformations. All modules appear consistent and ready for final validation.

tokenizer.js remains correct and stable. It calls injected normalize(text), extracts ASCII alphanumeric runs with interior apostrophes, returns array in order. All implementations align with spec. Ready for final round.
pipeline.js remains unchanged and fully compatible. Uses Object.create(null) for frequencies to safely handle 'constructor'. unique preserves first-seen order. Ready for final verification.
